focal_response.eligible_row: species_id == ADPE; site_id nonmissing; year integer; presence numeric and exactly 0 or 1
focal_response.duplicate_site_year_aggregation: 1 if any eligible row has presence==1; 0 only if all eligible rows have presence==0

layer_b.source_weighting: equal across eligible prior positive source sites
layer_b.no_positive_sources_rule: all ten Layer-B features are zero
layer_b.training_row_rule: for each inner-train site-year, sources are all eligible ADPE-positive site-years from strictly earlier years only
layer_b.inner_validation_rule: for each validation site-year, sources are eligible positives from strictly earlier years, including earlier validation years once observed; learner remains fitted only on inner train
layer_b.outer_rule: after selector is frozen and both candidate learners are refit on all calibration rows, each outer year is scored using positives from strictly earlier years only; after that year is scored its response may update state for the next outer year

selector.metric: macro binary log loss across eligible inner-validation years
selector.eligible_macro_year: year has at least one positive and at least one negative eligible site-year
selector.rule: promote Layer B iff augmented inner-validation macro log loss is strictly lower than baseline
selector.refit_after_selection: refit both candidate arms on all calibration rows through 2010, then sequentially score outer years without learner refitting

primary.metric: macro binary log loss across eligible outer years
primary.protective_null: delta == 0 because baseline was selected and always-augmented is not better
primary.conservative_miss: delta == 0 because baseline was selected but always-augmented would have been better

secondary: macro Brier for baseline, always-augmented and selected arm

interpretation.known_truth_translation_supported_only_i: selected arm has strictly lower outer macro log loss than baseline
interpretation.protective_null_means: selector transferred harm avoidance but not predictive improvement
